info.title: Sim API v2 — Files & Audit Logs
info.description:
Version 2 of the Sim REST API for the Files and Audit Logs surfaces.

## Conventions (v2)

Every v2 endpoint shares one response family:

- **Single resource:** `{ "data": T }`
- **List:** `{ "data": T[], "nextCursor": string | null }`
- **Error:** `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "details"?: unknown } }`

### Cursor pagination

Lists use an opaque keyset cursor (Stripe/Slack-style): pass `limit` and `cursor` in, receive `data` and `nextCursor` out. Treat `cursor` as opaque — pass back the `nextCursor` from the previous page verbatim. When `nextCursor` is `null` there are no more results. Total counts are not returned on lists.

### Rate limiting

Rate-limit state is carried in response headers, not the body: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (an ISO 8601 timestamp). A throttled request returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

### Authentication

All endpoints authenticate with the `X-API-Key` header (a personal or workspace API key). Files endpoints are workspace-scoped via the required `workspaceId` query parameter. Audit Logs endpoints are organization-scoped enterprise endpoints and require an Enterprise subscription plus an organization admin or owner role.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Upload, download, list, rename, archive, restore, share, and replace the contents of workspace files (v2). Workspace-scoped via the required workspaceId query parameter or body field.

tags.name: File Folders
tags.description: Organize workspace files into folders (v2). File folders have their own endpoints rather than being served by the generic folders surface.

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: Query the organization audit trail (v2). Organization-scoped enterprise endpoints requiring an Enterprise subscription and an organization admin or owner role.

get.description: List a workspace's files with opaque cursor pagination. Results are ordered by upload time. Pass the `nextCursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page; a `null` `nextCursor` means there are no more results. Use `scope=archived` to page through Recently Deleted — that is how you find the id of a file to restore.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `active` (the default) lists live files; `archived` lists the ones in Recently Deleted, which is how you find an id to restore.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return per page. Clamped to the range 1–1000. Defaults to 100.

post.description:
Upload a file to a workspace as `multipart/form-data` with a single `file` field. The workspace — and the optional target `folderId` — are supplied as query parameters (not form fields) so authorization runs before the request body is buffered. Maximum file size is 100MB. A name already taken in the destination folder is **not** an error: the name is auto-suffixed (`data.csv` -> `data (1).csv`), matching the in-app uploader, so a `201` can come back with a `name` different from the one you sent — always read `name` from the response rather than assuming it. `409` is returned only if a unique name cannot be allocated after several attempts. Use `PATCH /api/v2/files/{fileId}` if you need a specific name to be exact-or-fail. Returns `201 Created`.

Presigned upload is not part of the public API: it debits the storage quota only in a separate register step, so a caller that never registers would leave unaccounted bytes in storage. This buffered path debits inside the upload transaction.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Target file folder. Omit to upload to the workspace root. Supplied as a query parameter, like `workspaceId`, so authorization runs before the multipart body is buffered.

requestBody.description: The file to upload, sent as multipart/form-data.

file.description: The file to upload. Maximum size is 100MB.

400.description: The request was malformed: an invalid `workspaceId` query parameter, a body that is not valid multipart form data, or a missing `file` form field.

409.description: A unique filename could not be allocated in the destination folder after several attempts. An ordinary name collision is auto-suffixed instead, not rejected.

error.message: A file named "data.csv" already exists in this workspace

413.description: The upload exceeds the 100MB file size limit, or the workspace storage limit would be exceeded.

get.description: Download the raw bytes of a file. The success response body is the file content itself — there is no JSON envelope. The actual `Content-Type` reflects the stored file's MIME type (shown here as `application/octet-stream`); `Content-Disposition` and `Content-Length` describe the attachment, and rate-limit state is returned in the `X-RateLimit-*` headers. Lookups are workspace-scoped: a file that belongs to another workspace returns `404`. Error responses still use the canonical v2 JSON error envelope.

200.description: The raw file content as binary data. The `Content-Type` header reflects the file's stored MIME type.

Content-Type.description: MIME type of the file. Varies per file; defaults to application/octet-stream when unknown.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment disposition carrying the (sanitized and RFC 5987 encoded) filename.

Content-Length.description: Size of the file in bytes.

delete.description: Archive (soft delete) a file in a workspace. The operation is workspace-scoped and records its own audit entry. Returns the file id and a `deleted` acknowledgement.

409.description: The file could not be archived because of a conflicting state.

patch.description: Rename a file. Renaming only — use `POST /api/v2/files/move` to change which folder a file lives in. A name already taken in the same folder is rejected with `409`.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the file.

name.description: The new filename. Cannot contain `/`, `\`, or be `.` / `..`.

get.description: List audit log entries for the authenticated user's organization with opaque cursor pagination. These are organization-scoped (not workspace-scoped) enterprise endpoints: the caller must belong to an organization with an active Enterprise subscription and hold an admin or owner role — otherwise the request returns `403`. The `ipAddress` and `userAgent` fields are intentionally excluded from entries for privacy.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by action type (e.g., file.uploaded, workflow.deployed, member.invited).

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: Filter by resource type (e.g., file, workflow, workspace, member).

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: Filter by a specific resource ID.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Filter by a workspace within your organization. Must belong to your organization, otherwise the request returns 400.

parameters.name: actorId
parameters.description: Filter by the user who performed the action. Must be a member of your organization, otherwise the request returns 400.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Only return entries at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Only return entries at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: includeDeparted
parameters.description: When true, include entries from users who have left the organization. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

200.description: A page of audit log entries.

400.description: The request was malformed: an invalid query parameter, an `actorId` that is not a member of your organization, or a `workspaceId` that does not belong to your organization.

error.message: actorId is not a member of your organization

get.description: Retrieve a single audit log entry by ID, scoped to the authenticated user's organization. Organization-scoped (not workspace-scoped): the caller must belong to an organization with an active Enterprise subscription and hold an admin or owner role — otherwise the request returns `403`. An entry outside your organization returns `404` (existence is not leaked). The `ipAddress` and `userAgent` fields are intentionally excluded for privacy.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique audit log entry identifier.

post.description: Restore an archived file. Find archived ids with `GET /api/v2/files?scope=archived`. If the original name has since been taken by a live file, the file is restored under a suffixed name.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the file.

post.description: Move files and/or folders into a folder. `targetFolderId: null` — or omitting it — moves the selection to the workspace root. At least one of `fileIds` or `folderIds` must be non-empty. The whole selection moves under one lock, so a name collision at the destination fails the request with `409` instead of applying part of it.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the items.

folderIds.description: Folders to move. Descendants follow their folder.

targetFolderId.description: Destination folder. `null` or omitted moves to the workspace root.

intoFolder.summary: Move two files into a folder

toRoot.summary: Move a folder back to the workspace root

post.description: Archive (soft delete) files and/or folders in one call. Archiving a folder cascades to everything under it, so `deletedItems` reports totals larger than the selection. Archived items remain listable via `scope=archived` and can be restored.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the items.

folderIds.description: Folders to archive, together with their contents.

get.description: List a workspace's file-folder tree. The tree is bounded, so it is returned as a single page and `nextCursor` is always `null`. File folders are managed only here — the generic `/api/v2/folders` surface does not serve them, because every file-folder mutation runs behind a per-workspace lock and file-folder names are path segments.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `active` (the default) lists live folders; `archived` lists the ones in Recently Deleted, which is how you find an id to restore.

post.description: Create a file folder. `parentId: null` — or omitting it — creates the folder at the workspace root. The name becomes a path segment, so `/`, `\`, `.` and `..` are rejected. A sibling with the same name is rejected with `409`. Returns `201 Created`.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to create the folder in.

name.description: Folder name. Cannot contain `/`, `\`, or be `.` / `..`.

parentId.description: Parent folder. `null` or omitted creates the folder at the workspace root.

patch.description: Rename, reparent, or reorder a file folder. At least one of `name`, `parentId`, or `sortOrder` is required; omitted fields keep their stored values. Reparenting is cycle-checked, so making a folder its own descendant is rejected with `400`.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the folder.

name.description: New folder name. Cannot contain `/`, `\`, or be `.` / `..`.

parentId.description: New parent folder. `null` moves the folder to the workspace root.

delete.description: Archive (soft delete) a folder and everything under it. `deletedItems` counts the whole cascade. Restore it with `POST /api/v2/files/folders/{folderId}/restore`.

200.description: The folder and its contents were archived.

post.description: Restore an archived folder together with the subtree that was archived with it. `restoredItems.folders` counts the folder itself. Find archived ids with `GET /api/v2/files/folders?scope=archived`.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the folder.

200.description: The folder and its subtree were restored.

get.description:
Read a file's public share state. `share` is `null` when the file has never been shared. The encrypted password is never returned — `hasPassword` is the only password signal.

**Disabling is not revoking.** Setting `isActive: false` preserves the token and the stored password / allow-list, so re-enabling later resurrects the identical URL. To make a link permanently unreachable, archive the file instead.

put.description:
Enable or disable a file's public share. Requires workspace `write`.

The share token is always server-generated; there is no way to supply one. `authType` selects how the link is gated: `public` (anyone with the link), `password` (requires `password` on first enable), or `email` / `sso` (requires a non-empty `allowedEmails`). Omitting `authType` on a re-enable keeps the stored mode, and the org access-control policy is evaluated against that stored mode rather than against `public`. Disabling is never blocked by the policy.

**Disabling is not revoking.** Setting `isActive: false` preserves the token and the stored password / allow-list, so re-enabling later resurrects the identical URL. To make a link permanently unreachable, archive the file instead.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the file.

isActive.description: Whether the share should resolve. `false` disables without revoking.

authType.description: How the link is gated. Omit on a re-enable to keep the stored mode.

password.description: Plaintext password for a `password` share. Required on first enable; omit to keep the stored one.

allowedEmails.description: Allowed addresses or `@domain` patterns for an `email` / `sso` share. Must be non-empty when enabling one.

disable.summary: Disable (keeps the token and stored config)

put.description: Replace a file's bytes. This is a full replace, not an append: `content` becomes the entire body of the file. Use `encoding: "base64"` for non-UTF-8 bytes. The decoded body is capped at 50MB and still debits the workspace storage quota, so a write that would push the payer past its limit fails with `413`.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the file.

content.description: The file's new full contents, interpreted per `encoding`.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Your Sim API key (personal or workspace). Generate one from the Sim dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

WorkspaceIdQuery.name: workspaceId
WorkspaceIdQuery.description: The unique identifier of the workspace.

FileIdPath.name: fileId
FileIdPath.description: The unique identifier of the file.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` value from a previous response to fetch the next page.

FileFolderIdPath.name: folderId
FileFolderIdPath.description: The unique identifier of the file folder.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests permitted in the current rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the current rate-limit window resets.

V2File.description: A workspace file as exposed by the v2 surface.

uploadedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the file was uploaded.

folderId.description: The containing file folder, or null when the file sits at the workspace root.

folderPath.description: Slash-joined folder names for `folderId`, or null at the workspace root.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write, content or metadata.

V2DeleteFileResult.description: Acknowledgement returned by a successful archive (soft delete).

id.description: The unique identifier of the archived file.

deleted.description: Always true on a successful archive.

V2AuditLogEntry.description: A public enterprise audit log entry. The ipAddress and userAgent fields are intentionally excluded for privacy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

workspaceId.description: The workspace where the action occurred, or null for organization-level actions.

actorId.description: The user ID of the person who performed the action, or null when not attributable.

actorName.description: Display name of the person who performed the action.

actorEmail.description: Email address of the person who performed the action.

action.description: The action that was performed (e.g., file.uploaded, workflow.deployed).

resourceType.description: The type of resource affected (e.g., file, workflow, workspace, member).

resourceId.description: The unique identifier of the affected resource.

resourceName.description: Display name of the affected resource.

metadata.description: Arbitrary per-action metadata as JSON. The shape varies by action type and may be null for some actions.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action occurred.

V2FileListResponse.description: A page of files plus the cursor for the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

V2DeleteFileResponse.description: The result of archiving a file.

V2AuditLogListResponse.description: A page of audit log entries plus the cursor for the next page.

data.description: The audit log entries in this page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

V2AuditLogResponse.description: A single audit log entry resource.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code (e.g., BAD_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED).

details.description: Optional structured error context. For validation errors this is an array of field-level issues; for rate limiting it carries the reset timestamp.

V2FileFolder.description: A file folder as exposed by the v2 surface. File folders are managed only through `/api/v2/files/folders/**`; the generic `/api/v2/folders` surface does not serve them.

name.description: Folder name. Becomes a path segment, so it cannot contain `/`, `\`, `.` or `..`.

parentId.description: The parent folder, or null at the workspace root.

path.description: Slash-joined names from the workspace root down to and including this folder.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.

deletedAt.description: Set when the folder is archived (in Recently Deleted) rather than live.

V2FileItemCounts.description: Counts of what an operation actually touched. A folder cascades to its descendants, so these exceed the size of the selection.

V2FileShare.description: A file's public share. Never carries the storage key or the encrypted password — `hasPassword` is the only password signal exposed.

token.description: The public token embedded in the share URL. Always server-generated.

isActive.description: Whether the share currently resolves. Disabling does not revoke — see the endpoint description.

resourceType.description: The kind of resource shared. Always `file` on this surface.

hasPassword.description: Whether a password is stored for this share.

allowedEmails.description: Allow-list of addresses or `@domain` patterns for `email`/`sso` shares. Empty otherwise.

V2RestoreFileResult.description: Acknowledgement returned by a successful file restore.

id.description: The unique identifier of the restored file.

restored.description: Always true on a successful restore.

V2BulkArchiveFileItemsResult.description: What the archive actually soft-deleted, including the cascade.

V2DeleteFileFolderResult.description: Acknowledgement returned by archiving a folder, with the cascade totals.

id.description: The unique identifier of the archived folder.

deleted.description: Always true on a successful archive.

V2RestoreFileFolderResult.description: The restored folder plus what its subtree restore touched. `restoredItems.folders` counts the folder itself.

V2GetFileShareResult.description: The file's share state, or null when the file has never been shared.

share.description: The share, or null when the file has never been shared.

V2FileFolderListResponse.description: A workspace's file-folder tree. The tree is bounded, so it is always returned as one page and `nextCursor` is always null.

nextCursor.description: Always null on this endpoint; present so every v2 list shares one envelope.

V2RestoreFileResponse.description: The result of restoring a file.

V2BulkArchiveFileItemsResponse.description: The result of a bulk archive.

V2DeleteFileFolderResponse.description: The result of archiving a folder.

V2RestoreFileFolderResponse.description: The result of restoring a folder.

V2UpsertFileShareResponse.description: The share after enabling or disabling it.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request. Inspect `error.message` and the optional `error.details` for specifics.

Unauthorized.description: Invalid or missing API key. Ensure the X-API-Key header is set with a valid key.

Forbidden.description: Access denied. For Files, the API key lacks access to the workspace. For Audit Logs, this requires an Enterprise subscription and an organization admin or owner role.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found, or it does not belong to the authorized scope.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait for the duration in the Retry-After header before retrying.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

InternalError.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing state — most often a name already taken in the destination folder.

error.message: A file named "data.csv" already exists in this workspace

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body exceeds the per-request size limit, or accepting it would push the workspace past its storage quota.
